definitions.short: a kind of serpent (as snapping ), probably the cerastes or horned adder
definitions.full: H8207. shephiphon שְׁפִיפֹן noun [masculine] horned snake , ᵐ5 κεράστης (Arabic , Frey); — absolute ׳שׁ Gen 49:17 (|| נָחָשׁ ); = cerastes cornutus or Hasselquistii , compare Tr NBB 273 Post Hast. DB iv. 457 f. McLean-Shipley Ency. Bib. iv. 4393 Dr on the passage — שְׁפוּפָן שְׁפוּפָם, see S. V.
